nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Micropoint for Blemishes Patches

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: one with rosacea found the formula too harsh and unsuitable, one describes herself as a 'sensitive skin girl' and found the acid not too strong, and another with 'extremely sensitive skin' says the patches are not too harsh and work well.
segments.mature: One reviewer bought these for her football-playing son's breakouts and notes they work well without drying his skin, but there is little other material specifically about mature skin.

concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers note the patches themselves are drying and recommend following up with a hydrating serum and avoiding other acids on the area afterward; one reviewer specifically praises the product for not drying out sensitive/acne-prone skin.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report a visible decrease in redness within hours to a couple of days of application; a few say inflammation went down immediately, though one reviewer felt the patches did not reduce redness or pain at all.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers describe using the patches on deep, under-the-skin or 'blind' pimples and cystic bumps, reporting they came to a head faster, flattened, or disappeared within one to three nights; several dissent, saying the patches did nothing, made the bump feel bigger, or even worsened it into a nodule.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers most often report shrinking, flattening, or disappearance of blemishes overnight or within two to three days, including hormonal and cystic types; a notable minority (including several 1-2 star reviews) report no visible change or a worsened, more painful blemish.

extraits.texte: Do not recommend. Make my pimple worse and become nodule. Also, the microdart creates punctures and damages the skin, which eventually leads to scarring. I'd recommend other topical acne treatments or just wait until your pimple shows head and use the original patch.
do not recommend if you have rosecea. works but is too harsh on sensitive skin. i am the wrong demographic for this product.

extraits.titre: Like a shield for those sensitive acne
extraits.texte: Love that this helped my cystic acne flare. I've worn this during the day and sometimes at night and it still clears everything up. The only thing is you have to use it on dry clean skin so I couldn't fully do my full skin care routine because it wouldn't stick. Still love < 3

Worth a try for those early stage pimples. These realy only work on early stage pimples if you tend to get regular breakouts, not deep cystic acne. The acid is not too strong, even for a sensitive skin girl like me.

extraits.titre: lifesavers!! amazing at deflating cystic acne
extraits.texte: The normal zit patches are great, but these are AMAZING for those painful, under the skin, cystic acne. I had normal zit patches on a big cystic zit for a week, and they HELPED, but I had the micro point ones on for two days and everything deflated and didn't HURT when I moved my eyebrow. The micro point ones are bulkier than the normal ones, and there's less sticky area, so I have to make sure my skin is dry enough to adhere. They also don't hold up to splashing with water as well, but they're not made to be inconspicuous like the day time ones.

I had a gigantic cystic acne coming up right before a huge event. Thankfully, I still had a few days so I ordered these babies and OMG, they really did speed up the healing process and left my skin scar free! I used it overnight so it wouldn't be visible during the day and it really stayed put while I was sleeping. It does take a few days for things to exit your system, so if you can use these at least 5 days before any big events, if that's possible that would be ideal. They are a bit drying too, so make sure to use a deep hydrator like a hyaluronic serum for a few days after removing the patch. Also, since they are drying don't use any acids in the area, like salicylic acid, for probably a week after using and make sure to hydrate and exfoliate the area gently and regularly. I will be keeping these in my arsenal for sure!
I like these patches alot and they are not too harsh for my extremely sensitive skin
